reviews.text: Like Miner Gun Builder Great Game
good game. i like it. not for everyone
挺不错的塔防游戏。不过，既然以自定义模块配置为核心，那么应该完善一下不同配置的储存和载入，特别是在前期，不可能购入和升级重复的模块，所以当然是只把模块放入当前使用的塔中，但是目前缺少以整个塔为单位的配置存储/载入，使得这个操作非常麻烦。
very fun, grindy game with deep progression and near infinite customization
Sorta got to figure out a lot on your own and tinker around creating towers , but a pretty fun experience over all

10 hours on the demo loving the systems and then got the game for free as part of the launch competition, I am sure this is the kind of title where its players will see the videos or play the demo and know pretty fast they want the full game so they can play more and build and upgrade their arsenal. having alot of fun :)

A unique combination of games is nice for people who want to build something OP and then just let it play. It's a bit overpriced, and is a bit grindy, but overall is good. Expect a dozen or so good hours out of it.
Literally the best TD that i have ever played; not for everyone but this is peak
The game is free on mobile if you want to try before you buy!

Very deep and complex TD, and unique, never played a TD like this before....this one has got tons of combination of mods to build for each tower with interesting perks. Not for the casual crowd i'd say, I was expecting a bloons like bash, place 100 towers and win, but this one need planning and tower building and crafting, and then get 1 OP tower mow down a 10000 spheres.
Simple graphics does not equal a bad game. This game is an example of that!!!
Spheres are invading Earth-25. Build your towers and mod your projectiles — split it, add it, bounce it, chain it, multiply it! A true 1 tower = 1,000,000+ builds.

I like aspects of it but its got way too many menus which break the flow of the game, and outside of that the AI music and backgrounds left a bad taste in my mouth.
Build every tower as a laser puzzle that requires more energy to run. The actual TD battles needs refinement to help players understand what is going on. Huge game. Uncompromising. Promising. Tweaky.
